create.name: Craig Hamilton
create.bio:
Craig Hamilton teaches meditation as a way of waking up rather than a technique for calming down. The approach he calls direct awakening asks students to stop managing their thoughts and to rest, from the first minute, as the open awareness that is already present, letting that recognition reshape how they live and act. His own search began in ashrams and monasteries in Asia. He then spent eight years as senior editor of What Is Enlightenment? magazine and thirteen years in the EnlightenNext community, helped found Ken Wilber's Integral Institute, and has logged many thousands of hours of meditation, including a six-month retreat.

He now teaches almost entirely online, through courses published by Evolving Wisdom, the e-learning company based in San Rafael, California, where he lives with his wife, the teacher Claire Zammit. His central offering is a twelve-week course in the Practice of Direct Awakening; a monthly membership carries the work on with recorded workshops, weekly guided audios and a live three-hour online retreat each month. On his podcast, Meditation Changes Everything, he answers listeners' questions about practice and leads guided sittings, and a free online class introduces the method. He presents awakening as an ordinary human capacity that can be practised daily, and links personal change to a wider evolution of consciousness.

courses.title: The Practice of Direct Awakening
courses.description: A twelve-week online meditation course taken from home, with a recorded teaching session and guided practice each week. It moves step by step from first recognising awakened awareness to resting in it and carrying it into daily life. Enrolment is open at any time.
courses.price: $497 USD in one payment or 3 payments of $179 USD (regular tuition $697 USD)

courses.title: Awakened Life Monthly Membership
courses.description: An ongoing online membership for people who want to keep deepening their practice after the main course. Each month brings a recorded workshop, four short guided audios, a written practice guide and a live three-hour virtual retreat with Craig on a Saturday.
courses.price: $23 USD first month, then $47 USD a month; or $397 USD a year

free_resources.title: Meditation 2.0: The Miracle of Direct Awakening
free_resources.description: A free recorded class of about ninety minutes that introduces Craig's method and guides listeners through it. It explains why a restless mind need not stand in the way of deep meditation. Free registration by email.

free_resources.title: Meditation Changes Everything (podcast)
free_resources.description: Craig's free podcast, with around sixty episodes so far. Each one takes a single theme, such as distraction, surrender or the sense of self, mixing a short talk with listener questions and often a guided meditation.

Base: 'Craig lives with his wife, Claire, in San Rafael, California' comes from his author page on inspiremetoday.com (an older contributor bio, not his own site); Evolving Wisdom's footer address is also in San Rafael. Please confirm it's acceptable as the location source.

His site is copyright Evolving Wisdom, whose terms forbid copying: all wording is my own, and the only photo is his YouTube avatar (no image taken from craighamiltonglobal.com or evolvingwisdom.com). The avatar is served at 551 px, the largest available.

Videos: the channel shows only its 30 most recent of 98 videos without scripted requests; the 10 kept are the most viewed of those 30 (watch-page view counts, 4 Nov 2026). Older uploads may have more views.

The YouTube channel page served auto-translated Portuguese titles by default; titles here are the English originals (channel page with hl=en, which matches oEmbed). A zero-width character was removed from 'Dissolving the Separate Self'.
